I don't think the tariff will do what the sponsors say. The 2018 round on the same category raised domestic prices 11% per the Fed study while domestic output rose under 2%. If the goal is jobs, a direct subsidy is cheaper per job by their own numbers.
This laptop is PERFECT. Flawless. The greatest computer ever made and it's not even close. Buy it right now, you will not regret it.

Laptop review after 30 days: Cinebench R24 multi 1,180, sustained clocks drop 12% after 10 minutes under load, 96Wh battery gave 9h20m in our browsing loop. Keyboard is excellent. Thermals are the weak point for anything compile-heavy.
